title: Higher-order covariance matrices for non-Gaussian quantum states
summary: Covariance matrices lie at the heart of the powerful and well-established symplectic framework for describing continuous-variable Gaussian quantum states. However, since this framework only relies on first- and second-order moments, it is not sufficient for the analysis of non-Gaussian states because their higher-order moments are essential to capture some of their key properties. Here, we define higher-order covariance matrices -- more precisely, covariance matrices built from higher-order quadrature monomials -- which provide a simple way to evaluate the effect of Gaussian transformations…
